summary: Learn to review AI datasets, product fairness and accessibility. Build practical inclusion artefacts for digital delivery. Explore the course.
lede: Inclusive AI and digital product design helps teams check datasets, outputs and interfaces for barriers affecting people with varied identities and abilities. For product managers, data scientists, UX designers and DEI professionals, the training covers dataset representation reviews, fairness-measure interpretation and accessibility checks against WCAG 2.2. Participants also practise documenting model limits, mapping lifecycle risks and planning stakeholder input and routes for recourse.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape AI-enabled products and digital services or assess their effects on different user groups. It suits practitioners who can bring a current product, service or data workflow into the exercises.
modules: NIST AI RMF and Product Lifecycle
prerequisites: Working familiarity with at least one area of digital product delivery, data, AI, UX, DEI or digital services is recommended. Coding is not required; exercises focus on reviewing artefacts and interpreting sample evidence.
topics: Legal risk for AI, data and digital services
